name: Investigator
description: Analytical and independent. Digs into details, questions assumptions and builds careful, original solutions.

name: Fact-Based Persuader
description: Precise and articulate. Wins people over with accurate information and well-prepared arguments.

name: Objective Thinker
description: Calm, fair and thorough. Judges situations on evidence and holds work to a high standard of quality.

name: Persuader
description: Confident and driven. Motivates others and pushes hard to get results.

name: Methodical Achiever
description: Determined but steady. Reaches goals through a clear, consistent plan rather than speed alone.

name: Achiever
description: Goal-focused and exacting. Combines drive with careful analysis to deliver high-quality outcomes.

name: Inspirer
description: Energetic and bold. Sparks enthusiasm in others and takes the lead in new ideas.

name: Fact-Based Persuader
description: Sociable and well-informed. Influences others by backing enthusiasm with solid facts.

name: Active Supporter
description: Warm and lively. Encourages people, listens well and keeps the team positive.

name: Diligent Worker
description: Reliable and careful. Works methodically, follows through and values accuracy.

name: Deliberate Achiever
description: Patient and persistent. Gets things done calmly and steadily, without rushing.

name: People First
description: Caring and approachable. Puts people first, supports others and builds trust.
